title: Universal Band v1
description: Protocol-root gate DAG that runs before every gate invocation. Governs authorize, context-assemble, wisdom-invoke, and terminal record/escalate steps for all relational-impact events.
content:
# universal-band-v1
# See gate-client/src/dag/universal_band_v1.yaml for the canonical embedded source.
# This seed entry makes the universal band discoverable as a ContentNode on the DHT.
#
# The authoritative YAML is embedded in the gate-client binary at compile time.
# This seed is a reference copy for DHT-based governance lookup (Phase 3+).

name: "universal-band-v1"
version: "1.0.0"
event_type: "*"

input_schema:
  type: "object"
  description: "RelationalImpactEvent passed from the gate caller"
output_schema:
  type: "object"
  description: "GateDecision produced by the record-decision or record-decline synthesize step"

dag:
  entrypoint: "authorize"

  steps:
    authorize:
      type: "context-assemble"
      params:
        pulls:
          - from: "source-chain"
            query: "agent.identity"
            output_key: "agent_identity"
          - from: "manifest"
            query: "gate.event_kind"
            output_key: "event_kind"
      next: "assemble-context"

    assemble-context:
      type: "context-assemble"
      params:
        pulls:
          - from: "manifest"
            query: "space.type"
            output_key: "space_type"
          - from: "manifest"
            query: "gate.event_kind"
            output_key: "event_kind_ctx"
          - from: "source-chain"
            query: "agent.trust_level"
            output_key: "agent_trust"
      next: "wisdom-primary"

    wisdom-primary:
      type: "wisdom-invoke"
      params:
        constitution_cid: "epr:constitution-v1"
        framing_cid: "epr:universal-band-framing-v1"
        context_keys:
          - "agent_identity"
          - "event_kind"
          - "space_type"
          - "agent_trust"
        output_key: "wisdom_output"
      edges:
        - when: "wisdom_output.decision == 'allow'"
          target: "record-decision"
        - when: "wisdom_output.decision == 'decline'"
          target: "record-decline"
        - when: "wisdom_output.decision == 'escalate'"
          target: "escalate-to-review"
        - when: "wisdom_output.decision == 'need-deeper'"
          target: "record-decision"

    record-decision:
      type: "synthesize"
      params:
        input_keys:
          - "wisdom_output"
          - "agent_identity"
          - "event_kind"
        decision_builder: "allow-with-wisdom"
        side_effects: []

    record-decline:
      type: "synthesize"
      params:
        input_keys:
          - "wisdom_output"
          - "agent_identity"
          - "event_kind"
        decision_builder: "decline-from-wisdom"
        side_effects: []

    escalate-to-review:
      type: "escalate-to-review"
      params:
        target_spec_cid: "epr:escalation-target-app-steward-v1"
        severity: "medium"

  terminals: {}

metadata.phaseNote: Phase 2: wisdom-invoke is mocked (DevContext). Phase 3+: DHT lookup replaces compile-time constant in gate-client.
